title: Integrated cutline & rollout runbook for API / Console / Runtime release
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Objective: Produce a single, actionable release runbook and cutline decision matrix unifying API, Console, and Runtime components for the March release train. Scope includes milestone dates, scope-lock rules per component, deterministic cut criteria, rollout sequencing (canary/gradient/region), rollback signals, release notes ownership and packaging, and a cross-team GTM checklist. Acceptance criteria: 1) cross-team signoff from Eng/Design/Support/Sales/Docs; 2) published release notes draft in Drive + final release_notes.md in the repo; 3) runbook published in Confluence with automated links to dashboards and alerting playbooks; 4) cut decision matrix with red/amber/green signals and clear fallbacks for degraded runtime or capacity issues.
milestones: 2026-03-11: Feature freeze for non-critical UI changes (Console)
2026-03-13: API contract freeze and integration smoke tests complete
2026-03-15: Runtime performance validation (throughput/99th latency) and quantization QA

scope_lock_rules: All runtime performance regressions must be triaged and have an owner before scope lock removes them from the release bucket
UI polish not gated by API or runtime unless it impacts UX critical flows
Any change requiring schema or response-shape change requires explicit API compatibility signoff and bumping the release version in catalog
cut_criteria: Green: All automated end-to-end tests pass, perf SLOs met, no P0/P1 bugs open
Amber: Nonblocking P2/P3 issues only and mitigation plan with owner and timeline
Red: Any P0/P1 issue or failing perf SLO => block cut; fallback plan to previous compatible model variant or region routing must be present
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Smoke in staging with rollout checklist run (runtime dry-run, API contract check, console UI flows)
Phase 1: Canary 10% traffic in us-west; monitor token-level latency, error budgets, and customer errors; 2-hour observation window
Phase 2: Gradual ramp to 50% with health checks every 30 min; enable feature flags to gracefully degrade caching/batching if load spikes
Phase 3: Full region expansion after 24h stable metrics and docs/comms push
telemetry_and_gating_signals: Token throughput and 99th percentile latency against baseline (runtime-1.19)
Error rate by route (exceeding 3x baseline is amber, 5x is red)
Cost/unit anomalies flagged by cost-breakdown dashboard (sudden >20% delta)
Key customer impact signals: top-10 paying customers’ request errors or latency
